RootView hosts the bottom navbar, runs force-update check on init and app-resume, initializes chat socket + push handling on auth, and resumes pending Halyk payments. App version force-update hits GET /app-version and shows a non-dismissable dialog when current < min_version. Theme is Material3 light/dark with a custom green palette, persisted theme mode, OpenSans font.

Splash: use a LaunchScreen + a 3s async gate that flips a bool, then route to language picker if no persisted locale else home; replicate the redirect-guards on splashNotifier + locale. Force-update: on app launch and on scenePhase becoming .active, call GET /app-version, compare semver (current vs target version vs min_version), and present a non-dismissable alert (interactiveDismissDisabled + no back gesture) for force updates; optional updates deduped by last-shown-version in UserDefaults; open App Store via UIApplication.shared.open(apps.apple.com/kz/app/agroland/id6743326709). Dio → URLSession with async/await; keep an OAuth token-refresh interceptor (refresh on 401, retry) inserted before monitoring, plus a retry interceptor for transient Cloud Run cold-starts (GET only), plus a tariff-limit interceptor that surfaces a global upgrade dialog on 403 TARIFF_LIMIT_*. subsystem: API Client & State Management (Flutter → Swift rewrite contract)
summary: The Flutter app speaks to a single FastAPI backend mounted under /api/v1. Networking is a singleton Dio with a base URL loaded at startup from assets/config/main.json (prod) or main_dev.json (dev), both already ending in /api/v1. A chain of interceptors handles auth (Bearer token from flutter_secure_storage + automatic /auth/refresh on 401 with single-flight dedup), Cloud-Run cold-start retry (GET only), tariff-limit 403 → upgrade dialog, and a monitoring/analytics interceptor. All remote calls flow through BaseRemoteRepository.makeRequest which returns dartz Either<Failure, dynamic>; Failure is a freezed union (server/connection/local/fatalError) that parses the marketplace spec error shape {error_code, balance, required, missing} and nested {error:{error_code, feature, current, limit}}. State management is hooks_riverpod + flutter_hooks: feature-scoped Provider for repositories/services, StateNotifierProvider (often autoDispose) for mutable state holding AsyncValue<T>, FutureProvider.autoDispose.family for parameterized reads, and HookConsumerWidget/useEffect/useMemoized in the presentation layer. Models are freezed + json_serializable codegen (build_runner) with @JsonKey field renames and fromJson factories.

swift_considerations: Swift rewrite contract. (1) Networking: replace Dio with URLSession + async/await (or a thin APIClient). Base URL is env-scoped: prod https://backend-237397542353.europe-central2.run.app/api/v1, dev https://backend-test-42ygumvdeq-lm.a.run.app/api/v1 — both ALREADY include /api/v1, so paths in repositories are appended WITHOUT repeating /api/v1 (the OauthInterceptor refresh posts to '/auth/refresh' relying on baseUrl). Keep a Config bundle (main.json/main_dev.json) loaded via Bundle.main. (2) Interceptor chain must be reproduced as middleware around URLSession: OauthInterceptor (insert Authorization: Bearer from Keychain on every request; on 401, single-flight POST /auth/refresh {refresh_token}, persist new access/refresh tokens to Keychain, retry once with extra['refreshed']=true flag; skip refresh for /auth/refresh itself and device DELETE 401; on refresh failure → sign out), RetryInterceptor (GET-only, max 2 retries with 800ms×2^(n-1) backoff on SocketException/timeout/connectionError; skip /auth/refresh, /auth/biometric, /monitoring/events), TariffLimitInterceptor (HTTP 403 + error_code starts with TARIFF_LIMIT_ → surface app-wide upgrade sheet with feature/current/limit/message; respect skipTariffDialog per-request flag; debounced), MonitoringInterceptor (track success/error per endpoint, skip monitoring endpoints). Order matters: Oauth at front, then Monitoring, then Retry, then TariffLimit — AppWidget inserts Oauth at index 0 AFTER bootstrap added Monitoring+Retry. (3) Error model: reproduce Failure as an enum with cases .server(message, errorCode, requiredAmount, missingAmount, availableBalance, feature, currentAmount, limitAmount), .connection, .local(String), .fatalError. Parse backend bodies: marketplace spec {error_code, balance, required, missing}; nested tariff {success:false, error:{error_code, feature, current, limit, message}}; legacy {detail: String | {message}}; plain-string bodies (e.g. dealer/employees). Map ~40 error_codes to localized strings (INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, TARIFF_LIMIT_*, NOT_AUTHENTICATED, USER_NOT_FOUND, etc.). Use dartz-style Result<Failure, T> or native throws with a typed Error. (4) State management: Riverpod → Swift. Options: (a)swift-async-algorithms + @Observable view models + @Environment dependency injection, or (b) Combine/CurrentValueSubject per feature. Reproduce Provider (singletons/repos), StateNotifierProvider.autoDispose (view models owning AsyncValue<T> = .loading/.error/.data), FutureProvider.family (parameterized async reads). AutoDispose = view model lifetime tied to view; release on disappear. hooks_riverpod's useEffect/useMemoized/useState → SwiftUI .task/onAppear/@State. (5) Models: freezed+json_serializable → Codable structs with CodingKeys for snake_case renames (company_info, error_code, etc.) and custom init(from:) for UserType enum case-insensitive matching. build_runner-generated .freezed.dart/.g.dart become hand-written Codable. (6) Secure storage: FlutterSecureStorage → Keychain (kSecClassGenericPassword). SharedPreferences → UserDefaults. (7) Realtime: socket_io_client → Starscream or swift-engine socket.io-client-swift; chat events + voice_call WebRTC (flutter_webrtc → WebRTC.framework). (8) iOS-only TikTok Business SDK already wired via method channel agroland/tiktok — port the native code directly. (9) Gotcha: base URL in BaseRemoteRepository is re-read from appConfig.baseApiUrl and concatenated with the full path (not using Dio baseUrl), so the Dio baseUrl AND the per-request url both contain /api/v1 — the Swift APIClient must avoid double-prefixing; standardize on one approach. (10) Gotcha: refresh token is single-use; concurrent 401s must share one in-flight refresh (the _inFlightRefresh Future) — implement with an actor-protected Task in Swift.

subsystem: Marketplace core (announcements, category, search, favorites, regions, location, demand, agri-machinery, china imports)
summary: The heart of the Agroland app: a Flutter (Riverpod + go_router + freezed) mobile client over a FastAPI/SQLAlchemy backend. Listings (announcements) are created/edited via multipart FormData, browsed through a category tree or a recommended feed that interleaves VIP listings, searched with PostgreSQL whole-word regex plus a Kazakh<->Russian agricultural synonym dictionary, filtered by price/category/location/characteristics, favorited, and geo-located via country/region/district catalogue + Nominatim reverse-geocode. Separate sub-modules reuse the same announcement feed: a demand ("спрос"/wanted) board, dealer/business delivery-zone listings, China-import proxy catalog (MercuryX) with its own cart+orders, and a VIN-based agri-machinery registry (EGOV/ШЭП MVP). Promo v2 (boost/VIP/auto-renew) fields are embedded directly on each announcement.

summary: Marketplace buy flow for business announcements. Buyers add allow_cart=True business products to a cart, preview per-supplier pricing (goods/delivery/VAT) via the Smart Calculator, and checkout which creates one Order per supplier (routed to the supplier's business team). Payment is either Halyk ePay hosted invoice (card) or instant from platform balance; both apply a 95/5 commission split (seller/agrofinans) and mark payment_status=PAID independent of fulfillment status. Business sellers accumulate earnings on their wallet balance and request withdrawals, which FinansAgro/admin approve and push out via Halyk Payment API (outbound payout). Invoices (marketplace billing docs) and waybills (shipping docs) are auxiliary flows attached to orders.

swift_considerations: A Swift rewrite must handle three distinct payment integrations. (1) Halyk ePay Invoice (buyer card payments + balance top-up): OAuth2 client_credentials -> POST /invoice -> open invoice_url in ASWebAuthenticationSession/WKWebView (NOT a raw WebView — iOS 26 requires ASWebAuthenticationSession for hosted card pages to get Safari's 3DSecure and keychain autofill); callback is a server-side postLink webhook, the app never receives it directly, so poll GET /orders/{id} payment_status (current Flutter polls every 2s for 60s). Keep mock-mode short-circuit when HALYK_CLIENT_SECRET_INVOICE empty. (2) Halyk Payment API (outbound payouts): server-to-server only, no iOS code needed beyond admin trigger. (3) Legacy BCC 3D Secure: HMAC-SHA1 P_SIGN over the MAC data string with a hex key — reimplement with CryptoKit HMAC<Insecure.SHA1>; the response is an HTML form that must render in WKWebView. Commission split (95/5 default, PAYMENT_COMMISSION_PERCENT, per-tariff override) and refund-on-reject are backend ledger concerns — mirror the TransactionTypeEnum semantics if you replicate any client-side balance math. Withdrawal flow debits balance only at admin approval (not at request), with row-level locking; the iOS withdraw form must enforce min 5000 KZT and capture IBAN/BIK/name/bin. Order fulfillment status (supplier_query->...->paid) is independent from payment_status (unpaid/paid/refunded) — do not conflate them in the UI. The TRANSITIONS matrix must be reproduced or fetched. Waybills are read-only via /orders/{id}/tracking. Multi-supplier cart checkout requires the client to pick a single supplier (SupplierPickerSheet) because Halyk init takes one order_id — preserve this constraint. Riverpod StateNotifier/AsyncValue maps cleanly to SwiftUI @Observable + AsyncSequence; freezed models map to Codable structs. The /dealer/* routes are legacy aliases for /business/* — a Swift client should target /business/* and /payments/* directly. Finally, all Halyk endpoints default to test hosts (test-epay-*, public.test.onlinebank.kz) and switch to prod only via env vars — keep the same env-driven config so the test/prod toggle is explicit.

swift_considerations: A Swift rewrite splits cleanly into four pieces. (1) Google Ads: replace google_mobile_ads with Google Mobile Ads iOS SDK (via SPM), wrapping GADBannerView / GADInterstitialAd / GADRewardedAd in a Swift service — but the current production ad-unit IDs are still placeholder XXXX, so this is scaffold-only and must be wired with real AdMob IDs before ship. (2) TikTok Business SDK: the iOS side is ALREADY Swift (TikTokBusinessChannel in AppDelegate.swift) calling TikTokBusiness.initializeSdk / trackTTEvent / identify / logout with TikTokBaseEvent and an event-name map (login->Login, purchase->CompletePayment, launchApp->LaunchAPP, completeRegistration->CompleteRegistration). A Swift rewrite keeps this channel or folds it directly into a Swift TikTokService — the HMAC-signing accessToken flow is iOS-specific (Android SDK has no secret). SKAdNetwork support lives in the SDK. ATT prompt must be requested before init (currently deferred to SceneDelegate.sceneDidBecomeActive). (3) Story viewers: the two fullscreen viewers (stories_list_view _StoryViewerPage and BannerStoryViewerPage) are Flutter HookConsumerWidgets reimplementing the same Instagram-story UX (5s timer, progress bars, tap-left/right, long-press pause, swipe-down dismiss, immersive status bar). In SwiftUI rewrite each as a fullScreenCover with TabView(page style), TimelineView/Timer for the 5s progress, DragGesture for swipe-down, .statusBarHidden(true) for immersive mode, and .onLongPressGesture for pause. Persist viewed-state in UserDefaults instead of SharedPreferences (MainBannerViewedNotifier). (4) Promo v2 catalog/activation: the backend-driven catalog with per-SKU activate_endpoint (path with {announcement_id} substitution) and the 409 BANNER_SLOT_ALREADY_ACTIVE -> PATCH fallback must be preserved exactly — the Swift repository should replicate the path-substitution + method dispatch + PATCH fallback. Balance-charge errors (INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, BANNER_SLOT_ALREADY_ACTIVE, NOT_YOUR_ANNOUNCEMENT, IMAGE_URL_REQUIRED, INVALID_DURATION) drive specific UI (top-up dialog vs toast vs error dialog) and must map to typed Swift errors. Banner image upload is multipart FormData (file field) to POST /banners/main/image. Riverpod providers map to SwiftUI ObservableObject repositories / @Environment; the keepAlive stories notifier and autoDispose catalog provider map to explicit cache lifetimes. Backend is unchanged (FastAPI stays). The legacy AnnouncementPromotion views-based progress block coexists with the newer promo_v2 status chips — both must render in PromoCurrentStatusWidget. Cron-based expiry of boost/vip/auto_renew lives on the backend, so the Swift client only reads expires_at.

summary: Real-time 1:1 and group-style chat over a single shared Socket.IO (websocket-only) connection, with REST fallback for the chat list. Messages are text/image/video/file/audio/location/announcement/delivery_request, with voice messages recorded via the `record` package and played via `audioplayers`. WebRTC 1:1 audio calls are signaled over the same socket (call:* events) with TURN credentials fetched from GET /api/v1/turn/credentials (coturn REST, short-lived HMAC tokens) and ICE restart/reconnecting handling. Push notifications use Firebase Messaging for token + message delivery plus awesome_notifications for local notification rendering and deep-link routing. Six reserved system chats (IDs 31, 1001-1005) are auto-created on connect for every user (Акции, Agroland.kz, Оператор, Гид, Новости, Agro Market) with the Гид (1003) answering via FAQ+AI. The backend is a FastAPI + python-socketio AsyncServer sharing one sid-registry (ChatCacheService) between chat and voice-call signaling.

summary: Phone+OTP login with JWT access/refresh/biometric tokens stored in flutter_secure_storage, Riverpod-based state, and a dealer/business KYC + company-profile layer. Auth uses an HATEOAS-style task_id flow: POST /auth/login or /auth/signup returns mfa links, GET /auth/mfa/{task_id} sends SMS, POST /auth/mfa/{task_id} verifies the code, then the same /auth/login or /auth/signup endpoint is re-called with the task_id header to issue tokens. A separate biometric login path exchanges a stored biometric_token via POST /auth/biometric (token rotated on each use). Profile editing is additive PATCH /user/profile (name/email/is_vat_payer) plus avatar upload and a company-info sub-resource for dealers. Verification is a KYC document upload (multipart) with admin-approved status. Dealer subsystem manages products, orders, delivery zones, analytics, team-pool and employees over /dealer/* and /orders/* endpoints. Note: the backend registers /auth/login, /auth/signup, /auth/refresh, /auth/mfa/* but does NOT register POST /auth/biometric — the mobile client calls it but the exchange endpoint appears unimplemented in the current backend (biometric_token is issued at login/refresh but no route consumes it).

swift_considerations: Token scheme: backend issues three HS256 JWTs (JWT_SECRET, 730-day access + refresh, 365-day biometric) with {sub: user_id, type: 'access'|'refresh'|'biometric'}; the access token is sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on every request and refreshed via POST /auth/refresh with a single-flight interceptor on 401. For a Swift rewrite: store all three tokens in Keychain (equivalent to flutter_secure_storage) — never UserDefaults. Use a URLSession interceptor / TokenRefreshInterceptor that serializes concurrent 401s behind one refresh (the Dart OauthInterceptor._inFlightRefresh pattern) and signs the user out when refresh fails or the refresh endpoint itself 401s. Auth flow is HATEOAS-style with a server-issued task_id: phone -> POST /auth/login -> parse 'links' for mfaSmsRequest/mfaSmsSubmit -> GET /auth/mfa/{task_id} (send SMS) -> POST /auth/mfa/{task_id} {sms_code} -> POST /auth/login with 'task_id' header -> tokens. Signup mirrors this against /auth/signup with user_type='dealer' (BUSINESS) requiring company_bin. CRITICAL GOTCHA: the mobile client calls POST /auth/biometric to exchange the biometric_token, but the backend route.py currently does NOT register this endpoint — only /auth/login, /auth/signup, /auth/refresh, /auth/mfa/*. A Swift rewrite either needs the backend to add this route or should treat biometric login as best-effort. Local biometrics: use LocalAuthentication (LAContext, canEvaluatePolicy(.deviceOwnerAuthenticationWithBiometrics)) as the UX gate before sending the stored biometric_token; Face ID/Touch ID is local-only, the biometric_token itself is device-independent. swift_considerations: "Swift networking layer must model: (1) BaseURL + /api/v1 prefix; every request carries `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` and mobile-only payment endpoints additionally send `X-Platform: ios` (else 403). (2) Auth is not a standard 401 dependency — backend raises HTTPException(401/403, detail) with detail either a plain string or {error_code, message}; build a generic APIError decoder that handles both, and an authenticating URLProtocol/interceptor that refreshes via POST /auth/refresh on 401 and retries once. (3) Codable: all response payloads are plain JSON dicts (not pydantic response_model on most routes — FastAPI returns raw dicts), so Swift Codable structs must be hand-authored against the documented field names; many fields are Optional (nullable) and must decode nil. (4) Enums as strings: UserTypeEnum (individual|business|support; dealer=legacy alias), OrderStatusEnum (draft|supplier_query|supplier_accepted|supplier_rejected|paid|shipped|delivered|cancelled|completed — verify in tables.py), OrderPaymentStatusEnum (unpaid|paid|refunded), AnnouncementStatusEnum (pending|active|rejected|inactive), MeasurementUnitEnum, PaymentStatusEnum, TransactionTypeEnum, VerificationDocTypeEnum, VerificationStatusEnum, WithdrawalStatusEnum, PromotionPackageEnum, NotificationType, BusinessRoleEnum — model as String-backed Codable enums with a fallback case for unknown values (backend may add labels). (5) Big ints: ChinaCartItem.product_id and sku_id are BigInteger (int64) — use Int64, not Int32. (6) MFA flow: signup/login return task_id + HAL `_links` array ({name, href, verb}); client stores task_id, calls GET then POST /auth/mfa/{task_id} with {sms_code}, receives {access_token, refresh_token, biometric_token}. (7) Date/time fields are ISO-8601 with trailing Z (UTC) via utc_iso helper; decode with ISO8601DateFormatter, allow fractional seconds and missing timezone. (8) Multipart: avatar upload (POST /user/avatar), chat file/audio upload, KYC doc upload (POST /profile/verification/documents with doc_type form field + file), banner image upload — use multipart/form-data; doc_type is an enum string form field. (9) WebSockets: chat real-time is python-socketio (not raw WS) — use a Socket.IO-compatible Swift client (socket.io-swift) with the same room events (join_room `chat_room_{id}`, send_message, typing, read, edited, deleted); REST GET /chat is the fallback for cold start. (10) Halyk payments: POST /halyk-payment/generate returns an invoice_url the app must open in ASWebAuthenticationSession/SFSafariViewController; backend verifies via webhook (server-side), then polls GET /orders/{id}/payment-status. (11) Legacy aliases: keep /dealer/* and /dealer-finance/* paths working for old builds, but new Swift code should prefer /business/* — backend emits both business_id and dealer_id in some responses for wire-compat. (12) Currency/Decimal: prices use Float on the backend (not Decimal) — decode as Double, but format display with locale-aware CurrencyFormatter. (13) Localization: category/region/tariff models carry ru/kk/en/ch/uz/ky name fields — Swift should pick by app locale with ru fallback. (14) No OpenAPI-generated clients: response_model is only set on a handful of routes (e.g. /banner -> BannerListResponse); the rest return untyped dict — do not rely on a generated client, hand-map each endpoint. (15) Use URLSession + async/await with a typed API client per feature module (AuthAPIClient, CatalogAPIClient, OrdersAPIClient, ChatAPIClient, PaymentsAPIClient) sharing one token-store + refresh interceptor."

MercuryX (China catalog) — api/china.py proxies MercuryX product catalog/cart/order; product_id is BigInteger (int64). Backend forwards ChinaOrder to MercuryX.
SMSService / EmailService — MFA SMS code + email code (auth flow).
ImageService — image upload/processing (avatars, announcement images, category images, chat files/audio, banner images).
